_comment: Skip-list for `zig build wasi-testsuite`. After PR #661 made `wamr run` AOT-only (#644), every C and Rust wasm32-wasip1 fixture and ~half of the AssemblyScript fixtures fail because the AOT pipeline does not yet handle production wasm binaries (out-of-bounds memory access early in `_start`, AS runtime asserting at startup). Tracked in #662; drop entries as AOT regressions are fixed. Suite keys match the `name` field in each `tests/wasi-testsuite/tests/<lang>/testsuite/wasm32-wasip1/manifest.json` (note the double space in the AssemblyScript suite name — that's upstream). P3 has its own gate at `tests/wasi-p3-testsuite-skip.json`. See `tests/wasi-conformance-audit.md` for the audit log.
